title: 第13章 怒杀赵元膦圣品灵根第14章 选择雷系入天雷
content_zh:
;;
李观棋心眼所见，此时仿若天地只剩下了陆康年一人。
脚踏霞光而来的身影，犹如谪仙人一般，气质出尘。
这种人仿佛什么都不做，就只是站在那里，就会被人一眼看到。
“拜见宗主！！”
“拜见宗主！”
所有大夏剑宗长老、弟子、这一刻瞬间放下手中的所有事，对着天空之上的人影躬身行礼。
陆康年目光锐利的扫视全场，沉声说道：“堂堂一峰长老，拉拉扯扯，成何体统！”
“所有长老各罚三月月俸！”
所有长老听闻此话都是面色发苦，三月的月俸啊！
宗主在此，他们也不好说什么，只能点头答应。
蓝禾眼神幽怨的瞪了一眼陆康年，嘟囔道：“我后面几个月的胭脂水粉都买不起了！”
陆康年转头看向蓝禾，面色淡然的随意说道：“蓝禾顶撞宗主，再多罚一个月，这个月外门开课多加十次讲学。”
随后转头不再去看蓝禾那想要吃人的目光。
李观棋看到这一幕反倒是觉得这宗门之内的氛围不错。
一个天水峰的长老都能和宗主开开玩笑，不过是一月俸禄而已，对于长老之职不过是九牛一毛罢了。
宗主惩罚长老的内容，也是给外门弟子开小灶。
李观棋暗自喃喃道：“或许…这宗门是个安身之所。”
陆康年缓缓落在高台之上，抬头看了看那漫天霞光。
脸上带着和煦的笑意看向李观棋的双眼，没有显露出任何异样。

而是十分认真且真诚的说道：“我叫陆康年，是大夏剑宗第三十八任宗主。”
“你叫什么？”
李观棋虽然穿着显得有些破，但他还是理了理衣襟。
竟是做出了一个十分标准和贵气的晚辈礼！
而且李观棋自始至终都十分淡然自若，这等心性更是让陆康年高看了几分。
赵元麟艰难的从地上爬了起来，全身的剧痛犹如烈火焚身一般！
但这身体上的痛，却比不上他半点心中怨恨！
双眼死死的盯着台上的那道身影，随即转身离开了大夏剑宗。
李观棋深深的看了一眼赵元麟的背影，随后开口道。
“回陆前辈得话，晚辈李观棋。”
此言一出，陆康年顿时双眼一亮，脸上的笑意更浓了几分！

As far as Li Guanqi could see, it was as if Lu Kangnian was the only one left in the world.
The figure who came stepping on the glow of the sun was like a banished immortal, with a temperament that transcended the world.
This kind of person seems to be doing nothing, just standing there, and will be noticed by others.
"Meet the sect master!!"
"Meet the sect master!"
All the elders and disciples of Daxia Sword Sect put down everything in their hands at this moment and bowed to the figure in the sky.
Lu Kangnian glanced at the whole audience with sharp eyes and said in a deep voice: "The dignified elder of Yifeng, how can you behave like this!"
"All the elders will be fined three months of monthly salary!"
All the elders looked bitter when they heard this. Three months’ monthly salary!
With the sect leader here, they couldn't say anything, so they could only nod in agreement.
Lan He glared at Lu Kangnian with resentful eyes and muttered: "I can't even afford the rouge and gouache in the next few months!"
Lu Kangnian turned to look at Lan He, and said casually with an indifferent expression: "Lan He contradicts the sect leader, and will be punished for another month. This month, the outer sect will start teaching ten more lectures."
Then he turned around and stopped looking at Lan He's cannibalistic eyes.
When Li Guanqi saw this scene, he felt that the atmosphere in this sect was good.
An elder of Tianshui Peak can joke with the sect leader, but his salary is only one month, which is just a drop in the bucket for the position of elder.
The content of the sect leader's punishment of the elders is also to make small trouble for the outer disciples.
Li Guanqi murmured secretly: "Maybe... this sect is a safe place."
Lu Kangnian slowly landed on the high platform and looked up at the glow in the sky.
He looked into Li Guanqi's eyes with a warm smile on his face, showing nothing strange.
Instead, he said very seriously and sincerely: "My name is Lu Kangnian, and I am the thirty-eighth head of the Daxia Sword Sect."
"What's your name?"
Although Li Guanqi's clothes looked a little shabby, he still straightened his clothes.
He actually made a very standard and noble gift to a junior!
Moreover, Li Guanqi was very calm and composed from beginning to end, which made Lu Kangnian even more impressed.
Zhao Yuanlin climbed up from the ground with difficulty, the severe pain all over his body was like burning fire!
But the physical pain was nothing compared to the slightest bit of resentment in his heart!
His eyes were fixed on the figure on the stage, and then he turned and left Daxia Sword Sect.
Li Guanqi took a deep look at Zhao Yuanlin's back, and then said.
"Senior Hui Lu, junior Li Guanqi."
As soon as he said this, Lu Kangnian's eyes suddenly lit up, and the smile on his face became a little thicker!
